description: This file contains unit tests for the WebhookDispatcher component in the services package. It primarily tests the creation, configuration, startup, shutdown, notification, webhook dispatching, signature generation, retry logic, timeout handling, and custom header support of the WebhookDispatcher. It also includes mock implementations and a suite of test cases verifying different aspects and edge cases of the webhook dispatching process.

methods.name: newMockWebhookStore
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of mockWebhookStore, used for mocking webhook store interactions in tests.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_NewWebhookDispatcher
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new WebhookDispatcher instance with default configuration.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_NormalizeWebhookConfig
methods.description: Validates that WebhookDispatcher correctly handles default and custom configuration values.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_Start_Success
methods.description: Verifies that the dispatcher starts successfully under normal conditions.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_Start_NilStore
methods.description: Tests that starting the dispatcher with a nil store returns an error.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_Start_AlreadyStarted
methods.description: Ensures that starting an already started dispatcher does not cause errors.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_Stop_NotStarted
methods.description: Checks that stopping a dispatcher that hasn't been started does not cause an error.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_Notify_Success
methods.description: Tests successful notification and queuing of a webhook for an execution.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_Notify_EmptyExecutionID
methods.description: Ensures that notifying with an empty execution ID does not cause an error.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_Notify_NotStarted
methods.description: Checks that notification fails if dispatcher hasn't been started.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_Notify_NoWebhook
methods.description: Verifies behavior when notifying for an execution with no associated webhook.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_Notify_AlreadyDelivered
methods.description: Ensures that notifications for already delivered webhooks do not requeue.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_Notify_AlreadyFailed
methods.description: Ensures that notifications for failed webhooks do not requeue.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_DispatchWebhook_Success
methods.description: Tests successful dispatching of webhook with a mock HTTP server.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_DispatchWebhook_WithSecret
methods.description: Verifies that webhook dispatch includes signature header when secret is provided.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_DispatchWebhook_RetryOnFailure
methods.description: Tests retry logic when webhook dispatch fails initially.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_GenerateHMACSignature
methods.description: Checks that HMAC signatures are correctly generated and consistent.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_DetermineWebhookEvent
methods.description: Verifies correct determination of webhook event type based on execution status.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_HMACSignatureValidation
methods.description: Validates HMAC signature generation and format.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_MaxRetriesExceeded
methods.description: Ensures proper handling when maximum retry attempts are exceeded.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_TimeoutHandling
methods.description: Tests handling of request timeouts during webhook dispatch.

methods.name: TestWebhookDispatcher_CustomHeaders
methods.description: Verifies that custom headers are correctly sent with webhook requests.
